findings.evidence: The only characterizations are `spinPlus_def` at line 135 and `spinMinus_def` at line 139; internal proofs themselves require explicit `rw [spinPlus_def]`/`rw [spinMinus_def]`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` membership iff lemmas characterizing membership by the corresponding `evenOdd` component.
findings.issue: `spinPlus` and `spinMinus` have `_def` equalities but no `mem_spinPlus_iff`/`mem_spinMinus_iff` simp API, forcing consumers to rewrite hidden definitions manually.

findings.evidence: Line 146 proves `IsCompl` only for `spinPlus`/`spinMinus`; lines 265–284 bundle the subrepresentations and expose their underlying submodules, but no bundled complement theorem follows.
findings.fix: Export `IsCompl (spinPlusSubrep P hline) (spinMinusSubrep P hline)`, derived via `Subrepresentation.toSubmodule_injective` and `isCompl_spinPlus_spinMinus`.
findings.issue: The bundled half-spin subrepresentations are not accompanied by an `IsCompl` theorem, so the public API proves only a vector-space splitting, not the advertised splitting of `spinRep`.

summary: The half-spin interface lacks characteristic membership lemmas and does not expose the claimed splitting at the bundled subrepresentation level.
